acceptanceCriteria: Packets can carry span rows with explicit line ranges and a call-site reason, bounded by a declared line budget.
A sufficiency field states satisfied, insufficient or unknown per anchor with the missing anchor named; it never reports satisfied on missing evidence.
Measured on the frozen evaluation as core-span recall and sufficiency precision, with losing cases recorded.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: rows are path plus line and the packet is a top-k list with no statement about whether the set is sufficient for the task. Add span-level ranking (core span plus its call sites) under a line budget, and a deterministic evidence-set sufficiency check that reports whether the selected 4–8 units close the task anchors, abstaining explicitly when they do not. Prior art: SWE-Explore arXiv 2606.07297; ORACLE-SWE; arXiv 2609.20050. Owning spec: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md.
title: context: line-budgeted span ranking and evidence-set sufficiency check
